name: Colchicine
description: A tubulin-binding alkaloid approved for gout flares and prophylaxis, for familial Mediterranean fever, and as Lodoco for cardiovascular risk reduction. Its therapeutic index is narrow and it interacts strongly with CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibitors.

systems.note: Suppression of neutrophil-driven inflammation; the labelled gout indication.
Cardiovascular risk reduction is a labelled indication in its own right.
Myelosuppression is labelled and is the serious toxicity in accumulation.
Myopathy and rhabdomyolysis are labelled, especially with statins.
Renally and hepatically cleared; dose reduction is labelled in impairment.
Hepatic impairment raises exposure; interaction with CYP3A4 inhibitors is labelled.

monitors.why: Myelosuppression is the serious labelled toxicity in accumulation.

Labelled myopathy and rhabdomyolysis, amplified with statins.
Labelled dose reduction in renal impairment; the narrow index makes this consequential.
The inflammatory index behind the cardiovascular indication.
